thread:
alina: Hey — I'm putting together the internal release note and short announcement for the 1.6.0 rollout. Main bullets: model switcher, smarter batching defaults, and Dedicated capacity bugfix. Draft here: https://git.company/redwood/release-notes/1.6.0-draft.md

sam: Thanks. Can we call out the version pinning for Dedicated customers? Need the exact model hashes and the migration window. Also we should mention the canary percentages and time window.

lucy: +1. For rollback, ops playbook needs the specific command and a link to the migration runbook. If we have a pinned fallback model, include that ARN/hash.

maria: I'm fine with the draft. Suggest we add a short "what to expect" section for infra: small latency bump on long sequences for the new kernel, but cost per token down ~8% on average.

alina: Good call. I'll add that. For Dedicated pinning: we plan to pin to model sha: ab12c4f and keep the old variant cf98e2a for 48h as fallback. Migration window: Tue 10:00-13:00 PST. Canary: 5% -> 20% over 45m, then 100% at +3h if no regressions.

sam: Sounds safe. Do we want an automatic rollback threshold? e.g., error rate > 1.5% or latency p95 regression > 30% vs baseline?

lucy: Yes. Ops will trigger rollback if either threshold exceeded, and we should document manual rollback steps. Example command:```bash
# rollback to pinned model
redwoodctl deploy set-model --deployment inference-prod --model-hash cf98e2a
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference -n prod
```

ops-bot: deploy-check: Canary scheduled for 2026-05-12T17:00:00Z. Will post progress updates to #eng-releases and trigger alert if thresholds breached.

maria: Also mention the console changes: new per-route batching toggle in the UI and a note about how to opt out of automatic quantization suggestions.

alina: I'll include a short FAQ: how to pin versions, how to opt out, and contact points (oncall + solutions eng). Who should be listed as contact?

sam: Add @lucy for rollbacks, @maria for performance questions, and @sam for Dedicated billing/migration. Also include support alias support@redwood.ai for customers.

lucy: Minor nit: update the timeline in the draft to include the post-rollout monitoring window (24h) and who signs off for GA.

alina: Done. Final ask: can everyone skim the announcement text this afternoon? I want to send the internal announcement at 15:00 PST so PMs and SEs have time to prepare. Link to draft PR: https://git.company/redwood/pulls/987

sam: LGTM from me, minor wording tweak on the "impact" paragraph.

maria: LGTM

lucy: LGTM

deploy-bot: deploy:canary started for inference-prod @ 1763502000. Canary at 5% traffic. Monitoring: latency, errors, token cost.

alina: Thanks — I'll merge the PR at 14:50 to trigger the announcement. If deploy-bot posts any alerts, we'll convene the rollback call in #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
